ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixel distribution with localized high-intensity (white) clusters occupying approximately 10-15% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark pigmentation layer with high-contrast white annular and circular clusters (5-15 pixel diameter) distributed across the medial and lateral regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a deep vertical bounding-box offset and sharp convergence at the peduncle junction.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varied pixel-amplitude peaks along the entire trailing edge boundary; prominent jagged protrusions present near the lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Double convex curve transitioning from the median notch to the lateral tips, with a distinct posterior sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial detection of circular high-contrast white pixel clusters across the entire ventral surface, representing concentrated barnacle attachment scars.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, light-toned linear pixel disruptions visible on the left lobe surface, intersecting the rosette constellations.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Live barnacle colonies present as textured, high-intensity white/beige clusters at the distal tips of both lobes; extensive white scarring across the ventral surface.
